· 52주 위치(75.7%) + 현 가격대 역사적 고점 대비 약 5% 하락 구간
[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-2.5849→-0.4836) + 개선 중, 약세 수렴 신호

[지지·저항 구조]

· 스윙 저항선 ($749.53) + 돌파 시 단기 반등 기대

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($744.63) vs SMA5/20/50($753.17/$757.93/$763.62): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· SMA100/200($759.30/$729.61) comparison: Mixed long-term trend, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (75.7%) + Current price is approximately 5% below historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.9→42.4) + Entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.5849→-0.4836) + Improving, signaling bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $735.68) + Bandwidth at 5.87% indicates contraction.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($739.51) + Based on moving averages.
· Swing resistance ($749.53) + Breakout could signal short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Range-bound) + Lack of directional trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.23x) + Low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + Entry conditional on confirming directional bias.
